title: Stephanie Bice discusses Halt Fentanyl Act and charity softball game participation
text:

U.S. Representative Stephanie Bice, who represents Oklahoma’s 5th district in Congress, shared updates on July 16, 2025, regarding legislative progress and community events via her official social media account.
On the same day President Biden signed new legislation targeting fentanyl trafficking, Bice posted: "Great news! Today @POTUS signed the Halt Fentanyl Act into law. This legislation give law enforcement the tools they need to crack down on fentanyl traffickers and keep these deadly substances off our streets." (July 16, 2025)
In a separate post referencing congressional proceedings and an upcoming sports event, Bice addressed journalist Mica Soellner: ".@MicaSoellnerDC with tonight's Congressional Women's Softball Game on the horizon, I want to know what you think.... What finishes first, the game tonight or the rule vote?" (July 16, 2025)
Later that evening, Bice highlighted her participation in a charity softball game: "Great night for softball! I'm proud to play in the @CWSoftballGame, which helps support all those who have been impacted by cancer.
Be sure to tune in tonight at 7:30 ET on CSPAN, FanDuel TV or Monumental Sports. #BeatThePress" (July 16, 2025)
Stephanie Bice has represented Oklahoma’s 5th district since taking office in 2021 after defeating former representative Kendra Horn. Prior to her tenure in Congress, she served in the Oklahoma Senate from 2014 to 2020. Born in Oklahoma City in 1973 and currently residing there, Bice earned a Bachelor of Science degree from Oklahoma State University–Stillwater in 1995.
